title: The 15-invariant acceptance suite
action: One suite (test_msn_invariants.mjs) asserting all 15 issue #56 invariants as automated tests, each numbered and named: 1 concurrent planning no shared lock; 2 phase change isolation; 3 gate isolation cross-workflow; 4 heartbeat never erases binding; 5 disjoint-resource cells never contend; 6 same-workspace same-file lease: one winner; 7 cross-worktree same-file allowed with integration warning; 8 exclusive resources hard-block cross-worktree; 9 handoff isolation; 10 epoch fencing; 11 hooks never wait on store locks; 12 no long op holds a filesystem lock; 13 overview rebuilds from records; 14 projection delete loses nothing; 15 write-capable ops refuse without session_id+workflow_id+workspace_id (scope invariant 15 honestly: enforce where identity is mandatory today — leases/claims/ownership — and document the legacy-compat carve-outs, tightening is post-feature work). Reuse existing per-slice tests via imports/fixtures where they already prove an invariant — the suite is the INDEX that runs them all; write fresh tests only for gaps (5, 7, 15 likely). Every invariant green or the suite names which failed. Regen inside this cell: node scripts/render_plugin_skill_trees.mjs; node skills/bee-hive/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply; node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --write (+ impact_registry --write if suites changed). Canonical source: skills/bee-hive/templates/.

truths: all 15 invariants automated and green (suite output listed in evidence)
each invariant numbered/named traceable to issue #56 muc 15
prohibitions: no invariant marked green by assertion alone — each has a runnable test

Suite prints a verbatim '15/15 PASS: invariants 1-15 all green' summary line for msn-25's issue-56 closure. Regenerated release manifest + onboarding ledger + impact registry.
